about: Pont-Rouge is a city in Portneuf, Quebec, on the Jacques-Cartier River northwest of Québec City. Mill and bridge heritage, a river gorge, and a growing bedroom-community role on the Highway 40 corridor define the town. About 10,000 people live in Pont-Rouge.
seoSummary: Portneuf city on the Jacques-Cartier River northwest of Québec—mill-town heritage and river gorge.
knownFor: Historic mill town and river bridges
